note: The common-locus expression dngos po gsum gyi gzhi mthun du is kept as a complete d3 phrase; its local exponent is one thing which is three different things. The provisional glossary pairing gzhi mthun / wet and flowing is not evidence for this occurrence. tshad mtshungs is kept whole for identical valid perceptions, supported by the same terminology in C05:262,273,274 and the matching C15:431 passage. mi gnod is a d3 phrase because negation is fused in cannot. Both khas ma blangs constructions are omitted: English splits their assertion/negation around supplied participants and auxiliaries. No null stands for those unresolved divisions.
